_r_circ: Radius (um) of the smallest origin-centered sphere enclosing the
whole structure; measure it in CST.  An underestimate is caught by
_frequencies: A wide frequency range should be split into sub-ranges: each
sub-range gets its own (smaller) monitor sphere and mesh, which
keeps the memory bounded.  About a factor of two in frequency per
sub-range works well.  Omit range_edges_thz for a single range.
_extraction: lmax: multipole truncation.  Use ONE value for a family of related
designs (same matrix dimension for all) and choose the largest
value the family needs; see the manual, 'Multipole truncation'.
Wiscombe's criterion is an upper bound; the measured content plus
one order is the requirement.  The first solve of each sub-range
prints a warning if the truncation appears too low.
symmetry_n_fold: point-group symmetry of the cell about z.
0 = none (safe default).  A fourfold cell = 4 with the four mirror
planes below; reduces the number of solver runs about sevenfold.

_mesh: Fixed tetrahedral density in steps per wavelength (near zone, far
zone).  [20, 8] has been verified for metallic resonators of the
kind in this repository; raise it if the diagnostics at the upper
end of the frequency range look degraded (see the manual, 'Sources
of error').  Leave adaptive false; see the manual, 'Mesh strategy'.
_solver: Machine settings.  These belong in settings.json at the repository
root, once per machine; give them here only to override for this
_paths: Leave empty to use settings.json / environment variables / package
defaults.  run_root must be a local disk, never a cloud-synchronized
folder: CST locks and corrupts synchronized folders during solves.
